name: Alley Oop
description: Alley Oop keeps your development momentum going across sessions without the cost of replaying full conversation history. When you're ready to hand off, /alley distills your current session into a compact cold-start prompt — capturing just what the next session needs to orient and act immediately. Start the new session with /oop and you're back in the game. For parallel workstreams, /alleyarchive and /ooparchive let you branch, archive, and resume multiple threads independently.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill** and **5 commands**.

- **Skills** (1): `alley-oop` (Manages token-efficient session transitions in Claude Code)
- **Commands** (5): `catch` (Start a fresh session from ALLEY_OOP_MOST_RECENT.md and propose an action plan), `catchon` (Choose a timestamped handoff from the archive and resume from it), `help` (Show available Alley Oop commands), `pass` (End this session and save a handoff to ALLEY_OOP_MOST_RECENT.md), `passin` (End this session and save a timestamped handoff to the archive)

Installs with `claude plugin install alley-oop@claude-community` from `1azarus/alley-oop`.
